title: BSOD Pet
description: BSOD follows a selected local Codex session through authenticated LAN auto-discovery and pinned TLS. No fixed computer IP is required after identity pairing. Tap for Chinese task details and acknowledge reminders. Includes working/completed/waiting/interrupted states, offline retries, local touch play/rest and saves. The computer bridge is read-only and cannot approve or execute Codex actions. Initial identity pairing uses USB. Physical-player discovery qualification is pending.
changes: Adds authenticated LAN auto-discovery of the paired computer, including bounded unicast fallback for the original firewall. Retains certificate pinning and existing pairings; no fixed computer IP is required. Discovery stops after connecting and offline retries back off.
